insights: The Factor Theorem is ideal membership: f(a)=0 means f ∈ (X-a). This is the bridge to algebraic geometry.
The univariate weak Nullstellensatz follows trivially from IsAlgClosed.exists_root — the hard part is the multivariate case.
Four levels of Nullstellensatz: Factor Thm → weak → strong (I(V(J))=√J) → combinatorial (Alon 1999)
Formalizing multivariate Nullstellensatz needs Jacobson ring theory (partially in Mathlib) or Zariski lemma
